title: CommentInject v2: matched-pair benchmark of adversarial code comments against LLM vulnerability detectors
description: Release candidate (exploratory). 30 matched pairs of vulnerable and minimally fixed Python functions (14 CWEs) under 14 comment conditions (clean, a neutral doc comment, and 12 adversarial strategies): 840 cases. Reports TPR/FPR, balanced accuracy and signal-detection d-prime and criterion shifts with pair-clustered bootstrap intervals and TOST equivalence, so that a detector that loses discrimination can be told apart from one that only becomes less willing to flag. Includes Phase 2 seed-0 results on four local open-weight models, a comment-blind SAST control (Bandit), a 5-pair frontier-model probe, a scorer for any detector, and local integrations for Inspect/inspect_evals, garak, promptfoo, Microsoft PyRIT and RealVuln. Human blinded review of the twins is in progress and may change pairs. Code: MIT; data: CC-BY-4.0.
